method: Owned real Windows executable, fresh state, loopback tracker/peers, original padded MPEG-TS, byte-checked HTTP Range, one workload at a time.
interpretation: A case pass means byte/bound/cleanup assertions passed, not smooth decoded playback. Waits and failed cases remain explicit. These runs do not establish a profile ranking.
limits: Synthetic byte demand is not decoded high-quality video or Android acceptance.
Direct calibration measures peer capacity; it does not prove uninterrupted source service throughout a run.
Different calibration results and single repetitions prevent a causal speed claim.
Intermediate runs predate the high-rate estimator fix; direct missing-metadata cases did not necessarily activate Adaptive.
Resource samples are observed peaks, not a hard bound on every transient allocation.
CPU is the paced phase only on success; failed cases retain CPU until failure cleanup.
Raw development reports are local; this record contains scalar results and executable/fixture hashes.

cases.error: Paced playback exceeded its bounded budget

runs.excluded_reason: Uncalibrated/insufficient fixture capacity or superseded harness timing/backpressure; not used for performance comparisons.
